# Load libraries

```{r loading libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
```

# Initialize dataframe
```{r reading stimulus dataframe}
# Load dataframe
stim_df <- read.csv("C:/Users/Jet/OneDrive/Documenten/Universiteit/SPEAC SA/full_stim_excel_exp.csv", header = T, sep = ";") 
stim_df <- stim_df %>% filter(distractor == 0)

# Convert frequency into numerical 
stim_df$freq_sum <- gsub(",", ".", stim_df$freq_sum)
stim_df$freq_sum <- as.numeric(stim_df$freq_sum)

# Intialize factors
stim_df$Stim_code <- as.factor(stim_df$Stim_code)
stim_df$distractor <- factor(stim_df$distractor, levels = c("0", "1"))
stim_df$stress <- factor(stim_df$condition, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))

str(stim_df)
```
# Create random lists

```{r}
# Create index lists
list1 <- rep(c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "E", "D", "C", "B", "A"), 5)
list2 <- rep(c("B", "C", "D", "E", "A", "A", "E", "D", "C", "B"), 5)
list3 <- rep(c("C", "D", "E", "A", "B", "B", "A", "E", "D", "C"), 5)
list4 <- rep(c("D", "E", "A", "B", "C", "C", "B", "A", "E", "D"), 5)

stim_df$list_idx <- c(list1, list2, list3, list4)

# Create packs
packA <- filter(stim_df, list_idx == "A")
packB <- filter(stim_df, list_idx == "B")
packC <- filter(stim_df, list_idx == "C")
packD <- filter(stim_df, list_idx == "D")
packE <- filter(stim_df, list_idx == "E")


# Assign packs to conditions
library(car)
stim_df$random1 <- dplyr::recode(stim_df$list_idx, "A" = "E1", "B" = "E2", "C" = "E3", "D" = "E4", "E" = "G")
stim_df$random2 <- dplyr::recode(stim_df$list_idx, "A" = "E2", "B" = "E3", "C" = "E4", "D" = "G", "E" = "E1")
stim_df$random3 <- dplyr::recode(stim_df$list_idx, "A" = "E3", "B" = "E4", "C" = "G", "D" = "E1", "E" = "E2")
stim_df$random4 <- dplyr::recode(stim_df$list_idx, "A" = "E4", "B" = "G", "C" = "E1", "D" = "E2", "E" = "E3")
stim_df$random5 <- dplyr::recode(stim_df$list_idx, "A" = "G", "B" = "E1", "C" = "E2", "D" = "E3", "E" = "E4")

```

# Check mean sum frequency
```{r}
# check total frequency packs
mean(packA$freq_sum)
mean(packB$freq_sum)
mean(packC$freq_sum)
mean(packD$freq_sum)
mean(packE$freq_sum)
```

# Save the stim_df
```{r}
write.csv(file = "C:/Users/Jet/OneDrive/Documenten/Universiteit/SPEAC SA/randmized_stim_excel_exp.csv", stim_df, row.names = F)
```
